seoTitle: How to Change Your Name on a Google Workspace Account
metaDescription: Learn how to update your display name in Gmail or your full profile name in Google Workspace, plus how admins can change a user's name.
intro: Whether you got married, corrected a typo, or just want a more professional sender name, updating your name on Google Workspace affects how you appear in emails and across Google's apps. This guide covers both the user and admin paths for making the change.

steps.heading: Change your Gmail display name
steps.body: In Gmail settings, update the sender name field so your emails show the name you want recipients to see.

steps.heading: Update your full Google Account name
steps.body: Go to your Google Account settings to change your legal or preferred full name, which syncs across most Workspace services.

steps.heading: Have an admin update a user's name if needed
steps.body: For organization-wide changes, an admin can update a user's name directly from the Admin Console's user profile page.

steps.heading: Fix name sync issues across services
steps.body: If the updated name doesn't appear consistently in Gmail, Chat, or Meet, allow some time for the change to propagate or check individual app settings.

steps.heading: Keep your name professional
steps.body: For business accounts, use a name format that's clear and consistent with how your organization presents itself to clients and colleagues.

faq.question: Can I change my display name without changing my full account name?
faq.answer: Yes, Gmail lets you set a custom sender name for outgoing emails separately from your full Google Account profile name.

faq.question: Do I need admin permission to change my own name in Workspace?
faq.answer: Some organizations restrict this to admins only, while others allow users to update their own name directly — it depends on your organization's settings.

faq.question: Why doesn't my new name show up in all Google apps right away?
faq.answer: Name changes can take a little time to sync across services like Gmail, Chat, and Meet, so give it a short while before troubleshooting further.

faq.question: Can an admin change a user's name without their permission?
faq.answer: Yes, admins have the ability to update any user's name in the organization through the Admin Console.
